title: EP02 — Battle of Guandu, 200 CE: Hold the Line
framingPolicy: close, crowded, partially obstructed chest-mounted POV; no default wide battlefield shots
cameraPolicy: camera movement follows torso and body motion only; no floating, gimbal, drone, overhead or third-person views
audioPolicy: NO_SPOKEN_VOICE: no human words, no dialogue, no commands, no chanting, no narration and no music; breathing and brief nonverbal exertion only
battleFocus: sustained frontline combat experienced at human scale through shields, shoulders, spear shafts, earthworks, dust, smoke, unstable footing and limited enemy visibility
